provenance.source_ref: gitignored planning-corpus tool named as AUTHORITATIVE by 06-FORGE-SPEC.md §8 ("the forge validator (N/S-28.T2) supersedes it once the engine exists") and 12-QUALITY-CONSTITUTION.md §8; not present in the tracked repo, so this file harvests its OBSERVED BEHAVIOR only, never its code
provenance.method: Each case below reproduces one of .plan-audit.py's four structural findings (duplicate id, out-of-order/gap sequence, tombstone bookkeeping, per-scope active count) against a small synthetic PEWS tree, translated from the archived tool's prose-based ticket-id grammar ("EP/S-nn.Tn", inline "Tn TOMBSTONED" markers) into this engine's YAML-tree vocabulary. No v1 implementation code is reproduced; only the input/output behavior it was observed to produce is recorded.

cases.name: clean_sequence
cases.description: T1..T3 present, no gaps, no duplicates — archived tool prints 0 issues for a contiguous run.

cases.name: duplicate_id
cases.description: the same fully-qualified ticket id declared twice — archived tool reports "DUPLICATE <id>".

cases.name: gap_uncovered
cases.description: T1 and T3 present, T2 absent with no tombstone recorded — archived tool reports "gap at T[2]".

cases.name: gap_covered_by_tombstone
cases.description: T1 and T3 present, T2 recorded tombstoned — archived tool's "Tn TOMBSTONED" inline marker suppresses the gap finding for that slot.
